subject: Interactive zoom error with ggplot2 and POSIXct

messages.author: 7784c59b97ba258b
messages.subject: Interactive zoom error with ggplot2 and POSIXct
parts:
Hello,

Using the interactive zoom examples [1], I've tried to plot time series
data. It plots fine, but if I try to zoom in, I get the following
message:

Error: Invalid input: time_trans works with objects of POSIXct only

Is there any easy work around?

Thanks,
Josh

[1] http://shiny.rstudio.com/gallery/plot-interaction-zoom.html

messages.author: ebd2a309a1e18231
messages.subject: Re: Interactive zoom error with ggplot2 and POSIXct
parts:
Hi Josh,

I had the same.
The brush function using a date time series returns the min and max value as a numeric value.
To fix this convert it back to a POSIXct again.
For more info see the 'dates and date-times' section of:
http://shiny.rstudio.com/articles/plot-interaction-advanced.html

Good luck,
Michel.

messages.author: 7784c59b97ba258b
messages.subject: Re: Interactive zoom error with ggplot2 and POSIXct
parts:
Thanks, Michel. Adding a simple flag to my script worked:

if (plotTime) ranges$x <- as.POSIXct(ranges$x, origin="1970-01-01")
